race.comment: BELLSYM (1) ran a solid race on resumption at Donald over 1620m, getting home well into fourth. Improvement to come and the addition of blinkers is a positive sign. This looks very winnable. ON THE MAP (11) is backing up nine days after finishing third over 1550m at Mt Gambier. Strong run last time and is capable of taking this out. HASTA LA PRINCE (8) ran on well to get up for second at long odds at his latest appearance at Mt Gambier over 1550m. Look for him hitting the line from the wide gate. TUDAYA (5) is going okay and draws well. Is usually thereabouts and worth including in all wider plays.
